maker_inspection: Opened full 512px transparent hero and exact GLB normal/near/reverse/front/side/rear/top/nine-copy runtime contact pixels.
observations: Six long articulated legs emerge as three pairs from the thoracic region.
Small dark forewing covers contrast with longer pale hindwings; body and wing roots remain connected.
Two antennae and restrained large eyes provide readable head direction. Opaque pale wings avoid unnecessary alpha/depth problems.
warnings_disposition: Smooth shading is intentional for rounded exoskeleton and slender limbs; closed tube surfaces have no boundary/nonmanifold source warning.
limits: Color, 15mm nominal body scale, wing spread, limb pose, antenna segmentation and fine setae are artistic/simplified.
